lcc_original: 拉麥娶了兩個妻子，一個名叫亞大，另一個名叫洗拉。
notes: UNV 妻 → LCC 妻子: LCC appends 子 as a nominal suffix; WH0802 follows 妻子 as a unit.
UNV second 一個 (WH08145, שֵׁנִית 'second/other') → LCC 另一個: LCC lexicalises the 'other' nuance explicitly; WH08145 attaches to the full 另一個.
{<WAH09001>} kept implicit — no standalone LCC word corresponds to the prefixed conjunction carried by the Hebrew verb form.
